verdict.rationale: Steel is browser infrastructure, not a goal-driven agent itself. Natural-language, end-to-end task execution comes from pairing Steel with external agent loops: OpenAI, Claude and Gemini Computer Use, Browser-Use, CrewAI (which lists navigate and fill forms), and the Claude Agent SDK. The docs say plainly that the external SDK runs the agent loop while Steel handles the browser, so the developer must bring an LLM agent framework. Missing for 10: a native first-party natural-language task executor, independent or hands-on evidence of multi-step form-filling flows completing successfully.
